verdict.rationale: Moneybird documents recurring billing through its subscriptions feature ("Managing subscriptions: recurring billing for SaaS"), which covers the recurring-invoice half of the story. Nothing in the evidence shows automatic payment reminders or dunning for overdue customers, and "takes care of the rest" is too vague to count. Missing for 10: documented automatic overdue payment reminders, detail on recurring invoice schedule configuration, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a founder, I can set up recurring invoices and automatic payment reminders for overdue customers

citations.quote: Sell products, services, or subscriptions online with a dedicated payment page.
